notes: Hostinger Node.js Web Apps: set Package manager to npm (NOT pnpm — Corepack fails with ERR_VM_DYNAMIC_IMPORT_CALLBACK_MISSING). Install = node scripts/hostinger-install.mjs, Build = HOSTINGER_SKIP_INSTALL=1 node scripts/hostinger-build.mjs, Start = node server.js. Or single Build: node scripts/hostinger-build.mjs. Hostinger sets PORT automatically — do not hardcode.
